action->Spiritual Warden.name: Spiritual Warden
action->Spiritual Warden.description:
20 pies. Allies in the aura gain a +2 bonificador de estado a tiradas de salvación contra death effects y effects that objetivo or manipulate their souls.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kOGRUuyK04MjLc3m]{Efecto: Spiritual Warden}

action->Holy Armaments.name: Holy Armaments
action->Holy Armaments.description: Cualquier arma gains the effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} property rune mientras a monadic deva wields it.

action->Rebuke Soul.name: Rebuke Soul
action->Rebuke Soul.description:
El monadic deva speaks a word to cause una criatura's soul to recoil at its sins or an undead criatura to recoil at its lack of a soul. One non-good living or undead objetivo a un máximo de 40 pies recibe @Damage[5d10[spirit]] daño y debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:32|traits:damaging-effect] salvación.

Regardless of the outcome, el objetivo is then temporarily immune for 10 minutos.

Éxito crítico El objetivo no se ve afectado.

Éxito El objetivo recibe half daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo El objetivo recibe full daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo recibe double daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 4}.

action->Solid Blow.name: Solid Blow
action->Solid Blow.description: Cuando a monadic deva hits a objetivo for the second time during its turn with its mace, it inflige an additional @Damage[2d12[force]] daño as its arma shimmers with ripples of power.

Moonflower.name: Flor lunar
Moonflower.publicNotes: Las flores lunares son plantas carnivoras enormes que abren petalos palidos bajo la luz nocturna para atraer presas. Su belleza aparente oculta zarcillos feroces y un hambre insaciable.

action->Fast Healing 10.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]
Curacion rapida 10

action->Light Pulse.name: Light Pulse
action->Light Pulse.description:
@Template[emanation|distance:50]{50 pies}

El moonflower releases a pulse of bright light. Cada non-moonflower criatura in the emanation debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:23] salvación.

El moonflower no puede use Light Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Light Pulse]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Éxito La criatura no se ve afectada.

Fallo La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} for [[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Deslumbrado]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Fallo crítico La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for [[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Cegado]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Pod Prison.name: Pod Prison
action->Pod Prison.description:
Desencadenante El moonflower has swallowed una criatura

Efecto El swallowed criatura is wrapped in a tight cocoon y extruded from the moonflower's body into an adjacent square. La criatura continues to be Swallowed Whole. It no puede use Acrobatics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} a pod, but other criaturas can attempt to Rupture the pod. El cocooned criatura recibe half daño from any daño dealt to the cocoon. Once the cocoon is Ruptured, it deflates y decays.

action->Pod Spawn.name: Pod Spawn
action->Pod Spawn.description:
Should a Small or larger criatura die a un máximo de a pod prison, the pod transforms into an adult moonflower with full PG after [[/gmr 1d4 #Moonflower Transformation]]{1d4 horas} of growth.

El newly formed moonflower has its own consciousness, but some aspect of its trunk or blossoms resembles la criatura that died a un máximo de. El dead criatura's equipment remains inside the new moonflower y can be retrieved if the moonflower is slain.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazara con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Grande, @Damage[2d10[acid]] daño, Ruptura 20

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Morlock.name: Morlock
Morlock.publicNotes: Los morlocks son humanoides subterraneos degenerados que acechan en ruinas hundidas y cavernas oscuras. Cazan en grupos, trepan por paredes con facilidad y atacan desde posiciones inesperadas.
Morlock.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra enfermedad y veneno

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Disea.name: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra enfermedad y veneno

action->Instinctual Tinker.name: Manitas instintivo
action->Instinctual Tinker.description:
El morlock trastea con un constructo o peligro mecánico adyacente. Haz una prueba de @Check[crafting|defense:fortitude] contra la CD de Fortaleza del constructo o del peligro. El morlock no puede tener éxito si el nivel del objetivo es más del doble que el nivel del morlock.

Éxito crítico El objetivo obtiene @Damage[4d6[healing]]{4d6 PG} y un bonificador +1 por circunstancia a las tiradas de ataque durante 1 minuto.

Éxito El objetivo obtiene @Damage[2d6[healing]]{2d6 PG}.

Fallo crítico El morlock se hiere a sí mismo y sufre @Damage[2d6]{2d6 de daño} (normalmente contundente, cortante o perforante, pero podría ser de otro tipo a discreción del DJ).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TEzLEXBZzNCp6flg]{Efecto: Manitas instintivo (éxito crítico)}

action->Leap Attack.name: Ataque en salto
action->Leap Attack.description:
El morlock da una Zancada hasta el doble de su Velocidad, durante la cual hace un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{Salto de altura} o un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Salto de longitud}. En cualquier momento de su movimiento, el morlock puede dar un Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo contra un enemigo que esté a su alcance.

El morlock no puede usar el Ataque en salto hasta pasado 1 asalto.

action->Sneak Attack.description: Los Golpes de un morlock infligen 1d6 de daño de precisión adicional a las criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenidas}.
action->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo

action->Swarming Stance.name: Posición de plaga
action->Swarming Stance.description: Un morlock puede compartir el mismo espacio con otro, pero no puede haber más de dos morlock en el mismo espacio. Cuando dos de ellos comparten el mismo espacio, obtienen un bonificador +1 por circunstancia a las tiradas de ataque.

Movanic Deva.name: Deva movanico
Movanic Deva.publicNotes: Los devas movanicos son guardianes celestiales del Plano Material y de los lugares donde las fuerzas de la vida luchan contra corrupciones impias. Su luz curativa se combina con una severa capacidad marcial.

spell->Awaken Animal.target: 1 animal hasta el nivel de la Tabla 7-1

weapon->Bastard Sword.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6KWYmeRMxsQfWhhJ]

Este broad-bladed sword, sometimes called the hand-and-a-half sword, has a longer grip so it can be held in one hand or used with two hands to provide extra piercing or slashing power.

action->Aura of Vitality.name: Aura of Vitality
action->Aura of Vitality.description:
20 pies. Allies in the movanic deva's aura gain a +1 bonificador de estado a all tiradas de salvación, resistance 10 to vitality y daño de vacío, y are unharmed by the effects of a plane's vitality y void rasgos. Animals in the aura of 12th level or lower don't attack the movanic deva or the deva's allies unless they are controlled or otherwise forced to attack.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.RjrsiEloXs7ze1TZ]{Efecto: Aura of Vitality}

action->Dispelling Field.name: Dispelling Field
action->Dispelling Field.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto El movanic deva attempts to unravel unwelcome magic effects on allies a un máximo de its aura of vitality to protect them from malevolent forces. El movanic deva attempts a counteract check against as many conjuro effects affecting allies in the área as it wishes with a +19 counteract modifier y a counteract rank of 4, rolling once for the selected effects.

action->Flaming Armaments.name: Flaming Armaments
action->Flaming Armaments.description: Cuando a movanic deva wields a arma, that arma gains the effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming} rune.

Mudwretch.name: Cieno de barro
Mudwretch.publicNotes: Los cienos de barro son masas animadas de lodo, limo y resentimiento elemental. Surgen de humedales contaminados y se arrastran sobre intrusos para ahogarlos en fango.

action->Muddy Field.name: Campo embarrado
action->Muddy Field.description: 10 pies (3 m). El suelo de la zona se convierte en terreno difícil para todas las criaturas que no sean miserables de barro.

action->Susceptible to Desiccation.name: Susceptible a la desecación
action->Susceptible to Desiccation.description:
Si un miserable de barro sufre algún daño por @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.M0jQlpQYUr0pp2Sv]{Desecar} o un efecto similar, sufre 10 o más daño por fuego de un solo efecto, o pasa más de 24 horas alejado de una fuente de hidratación suficiente (como un pantano, un río, un pozo o una lluvia reciente), se deshidrata.

Mientras esté deshidratado, el miserable de barro no puede usar Vómito de barro y pasa a estar @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{indispuesto 2} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} hasta que se sumerja completamente en agua, pase 1 minuto bajo la lluvia o se rehidrate de alguna otra manera (como mediante Hidratación sangrienta).

action->Gory Hydration.name: Hidratación sangrienta
action->Gory Hydration.description:
Requisitos El miserable de barro está deshidratado

Desencadenante El miserable de barro inflige daño mediante Constreñir a una criatura viva que tenga sangre

Efecto El miserable de barro aprieta más fuerte, infligiendo @Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6 de daño persistente por sangrado} al objetivo. El miserable de barro absorbe esta sangre, eliminando cualquier penalizador que tuviera como resultado de estar deshidratado.

action->Mud Puddle.name: Charco de barro
action->Mud Puddle.description: Hasta su próxima acción, el miserable de barro parece un charco de barro normal y corriente. Tiene un resultado automático de 20 en las pruebas de Engaño para hacerse pasar por un charco de barro y puede dar un Golpe de puño contra una criatura que camine sobre el charco de barro como reacción.

action->Spew Mud.name: Vómito de barro
action->Spew Mud.description:
El miserable de barro escupe una @Template[line|distance:20]{línea de 20 pies (6 m)} de barro presurizado que inflige @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]]{2d10 de daño contundente} (salvación @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]). En caso de fallo crítico, a la criatura también se le impone un penalizador de estado -10 pies (3 m) a su Velocidad durante 1 asalto.

El miserable de barro no puede volver a usar Vómito de barro hasta pasados [[/gmr 1d4 #Recarga vómito de barro]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Nabasu.name: Nabasu
Nabasu.publicNotes: Los nabasus son demonios voraces que se alimentan de almas y carne mortal. Merodean por cementerios, campos de batalla y ciudades en decadencia, creciendo en poder a medida que consumen vida.

action->Telepathy 100 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.kdhbPaBMK1d1fpbA]
Telepatia 100 pies

action->Death-Stealing Gaze.name: Mirada roba-muerte
action->Death-Stealing Gaze.description: 30 pies. Cuando a non-demon ends its turn in the aura, it debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:23] salvación. Si it fails, it queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1}.

action->Starvation Vulnerability.name: Starvation Vulnerability
action->Starvation Vulnerability.description: Una nabasu denied food suffers painful backlash as their demonic NATURE feeds on their own corrupted spirituality. Si a nabasu's Consume Death is disrupted (such as by a fighter using Disruptive Stance) or una criatura resists the effect with a éxito crítico, the nabasu recibe @Damage[4d6[mental]] daño.

action->Consume Death.name: Consumir muerte
action->Consume Death.description:
El nabasu focuses their death-stealing gaze upon a single objetivo they can see a un máximo de 30 pies. El objetivo must immediately attempt a Fortaleza save against death-stealing gaze.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectado y the nabasu suffers starvation vulnerability.

Éxito La criatura no se ve afectada.

Fallo La criatura is affected by death-stealing gaze y queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1}. Si la criatura was already drained 1 by the death-stealing gaze before attempting the save, a failed save increases the value of the drained condition by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. El nabasu gains 10 PG temporales, y the drained criatura is temporarily immune until the start of the nabasu's next turn.

Fallo crítico Como fallo, but la criatura increases the amount of drain by 2.

action->Stolen Death.name: Stolen Death
action->Stolen Death.description: Una criatura that dies mientras suffering drain from a nabasu's death-stealing gaze rises as a ghoul the next midnight.

Nalfeshnee.name: Nalfeshnee
Nalfeshnee.publicNotes: Los nalfeshnees son demonios enormes y grotescos que actuan como jueces corruptos, estrategas y senores de guerra del Abismo. Su arrogancia es tan inmensa como su apetito.
Nalfeshnee.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Forfeiture Aversion.name: Forfeiture Aversion
action->Forfeiture Aversion.description: Una nalfeshnee's greed is such that losing possessions causes them harm. Si an item is stolen from a nalfeshnee, the demon recibe @Damage[(3d6+10)[mental]] daño.

action->Greedy Grab.name: Greedy Presa
action->Greedy Grab.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura critically fails a arma Golpe against the nalfeshnee

Efecto El nalfeshnee attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the arma used in the triggering Golpe at a -2 penalizador por circunstancia. Con un éxito, the nalfeshnee steals the arma.

action->Claim Wealth.name: Claim Wealth
action->Claim Wealth.description: El nalfeshnee steals all unattended items glowing with its Light of Avarice into an extradimensional space. El demon can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{INTERACT} to regurgitate any number of these items into their hand or onto the ground. Si the demon dies, is affected by a teleportation effect, or consumes an extradimensional space (such as a bag of holding), they vomit up all the items.

action->Light of Avarice.name: Light of Avarice
action->Light of Avarice.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto Beams of unholy light shoot from the nalfeshnee toward four items a un máximo de 60 pies. Si someone is holding or wearing a objetivoed item, they can keep it from being affected with a successful @Check[reflex|dc:34] salvación. For 1 minuto, the affected items glow in nauseating colors. Cualquier non-demon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it holds, wears, or touches a glowing item.

Recovering from the sickness requires a successful @Check[will|dc:29] salvación instead of a Fortaleza save. Ending the sickness this way ends the ralentizado condition y makes la criatura temporarily immune to Light of Avarice for 24 horas.

Si la criatura removes or drops the item, both conditions end immediately but la criatura doesn't quedan immune to Light of Avarice.

Necrophidius.name: Necrofidio
Necrophidius.publicNotes: Los necrofidios son constructos serpentinos hechos de hueso y magia, creados como guardianes silenciosos. Su danza hipnotica deja a sus víctimas indefensas antes de atacar con colmillos envenenados.

action->Dance of Death.name: Danza de la muerte
action->Dance of Death.description:

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectado y is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

Éxito La criatura is unnerved by the swaying y queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of the necrophidius's next turn.

Fallo La criatura is distracted by the swaying, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. After it recovers, it is desprevenido until the end of the necrophidius's next turn.

Fallo crítico Como fallo, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

action->Necrophidic Paralysis.name: Necrophidic Paralysis
action->Necrophidic Paralysis.description: Una living criatura bitten by a necrophidius must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, y the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 for each save attempted. Una criatura that succeeds at this save is temporarily immune to necrophidic paralysis for 24 horas.

Oread Guard.name: Guardia oread
Oread Guard.publicNotes:
Elemental earth laces through the bones of oreads, who appear similar to stone statues of their mortal ancestry, with delicate crystals in place of hair, fur, or scales. Oreads are stoic y slow to plan but are of steadfast resolve y unwavering in their convictions.

El typical oread cherishes quiet seclusion. Yet as they age, many oreads find themselves inexplicably drawn to some far-flung location with a pull like that exerted on the needle of a compass-intangible, constant, y ultimately irresistible. El destination of this mysterious pilgrimage is unique to each oread, though it usually ends in some place of great mystical power, natural splendor, or esoteric learning. Most oreads are drawn to a place with which they are somewhat familiar, but a rare few feel drawn to travel in a seemingly random direction, departing with only their hope that they'll discover whatever mystery lies at the end of their invisible path.

Many oreads find that the role of a guard suits their personality well, for in such a role they can feel as if they are helping to promote order but also find time to stand vigil as lone sentinels over a specific portion of a fortification or a remote location on a wilderness trail.

Ostiarius.publicNotes: Ostiariuses, as emissaries of the velstracs, tend to the portals between the Shadow Plane y the Material Plane. They not only escort other velstracs into the world of mortals, but also work to entice mortals into the realms of the velstracs- from which most mortals never leave. Among the most pleasant y persuasive of the velstracs, ostiariuses are prepared to converse for horas upon any topic, y they are skilled at returning, again y again, to the subject of the delights found in their perverse philosophies. Ostiariuses stand over 6 pies tall, y individuals range from skeletally thin to hugely corpulent.

Este fascination lasts for 1 asalto or until the ostiarius recibe any hostile action against la criatura or la criatura's allies. Whether la criatura succeeds at or fails the save, it is temporarily immune for 1 hora.

Osyluth.name: Osyluth
Osyluth.publicNotes:
Un osyluth es un inquisidor sin parangón que se deleita con el sadismo y la tortura por los que el Infierno es tan conocido. La misión de estos diablos es buscar herejías, tanto entre los mortales como entre otros infernales, un mandamiento que mantienen con un fervor inquebrantable. Se reproducen en los pantanos alimentados por el río Estigia de la quinta capa del Infierno, Estigia; allá donde las herejías y las almas de los herejes se estancan, acaban surgiendo los osyluths. En los rincones remotos de esa misma capa del Infierno, construyen enormes colmenas calcificadas en las que llevan a cabo sus viles interrogatorios y perfeccionan sus artes de tortura usando a diablos menores y suplicantes por igual.

Cada tipo de diablo desempeña un papel particular en la burocracia y jerarquía del Infierno, aunque algunos tienen funciones mucho más especializadas que otros.

Peluda.name: Peluda
Peluda.publicNotes:
Peludas are wild y savage dragons that favor reedy marshlands, sparsely forested bogs, y river valleys for lairs. Una single peluda typically claims a stretch of waterways a few miles in length, then systematically drives off any potential rivals so that the peluda can despoil the land as they please, leaving clawed footprints on muddy riverbanks, toppling trees, y impaling half-eaten corpses on their quills as trophies left to rot. They venture beyond their domains to hunt, roasting prey with their breath or pulverizing them with their tails, burning y killing for cruel sport before slithering, sated, back to their mucky lairs.

Peludas despise weakness y loala criaturas smaller than themselves, especially humanoids, whom they see as fragile y soft, good only for eating or breaking. In contrast, peludas have a massive inferiority complex regarding more impressive criaturas-especially larger y stronger dragons. Peludas will try anything to quedan stronger, including ingesting shiny coins, gems, y jewelry, which old folk tales claim will strengthen their quills y fire breath.
Peluda.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Vulnerable Tail.description: Si the peluda recibe 30 or more daño cortante from a impacto crítico, the attacker severs the peluda's tail. El peluda recibe @Damage[2d6[bleed]] y no puede make tail attacks until their tail grows back (in about 1 week).

Peryton.name: Peryton
Peryton.publicNotes:
El peryton is an amalgam of horror, merging the features of a stag, wolf, y hawk. They love using shadows to stalk their victims before ripping out their still-beating hearts y relishing the dying pulse as they swallow them whole, so the doomed victims spends their last moments watching as their flesh is consumed.

Despite perytons' animalistic appearance y brutal behavior, they are viciously cunning y as intelligent as humans. Their preferred tactic is to find a lone traveler y stalk it from on high. Most perytons are loners who loathe all other criaturas. Estos feelings extend to other perytons as well, y adult males attack each other on sight as surely as they attack anything else.

Once per year, perytons mate. El males offer up hearts they have collected from humanoids to attract females. Those that manage to secure a mate rarely survive long though, as their mating ritual is short y violent. Female perytons generally abandon their eggs after laying them, so newly hatched perytons must fend for themselves from the moment they emerge.

Una lone peryton typically builds a nest in a rocky overhang or an exceptionally tall y strong tree where they can observe nearby lands. Although they aren't particularly interested in wealth, perytons do like to collect small objects from their victims. During those times between hunts, they sometimes study these trophies in order to relive the memories of victims' last moments y the taste of victims' hearts.

action->Heart Ripper.name: Arrancacorazones
action->Heart Ripper.description: El peryton rips out the heart of an adjacent corpse with their jaws. La criatura must have died in the last minute. As the peryton rips the heart free y swallows it whole, they regain @Damage[2d6[healing]] PG, y any non-peryton that witnesses this event must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a fallo crítico).

action->Mimic Shadow.name: Mimic Shadow
action->Mimic Shadow.description:
Requisitos El objetivo must be casting a shadow

Efecto El peryton Flies, going no higher than 20 pies over el objetivo criatura. El objetivo criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] salvación or the peryton's shadow changes to match that cast by el objetivo criatura. With their shadow so transformed, the peryton gains a +2 bonificador de estado a attack y tiradas de daño against that criatura.

In addition, each time the peryton successfully Golpes that criatura, la criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}, or increase its asustado condition by 1 if it's already asustado. Este is an emotion y fear effect. El shadow remains transformed for 1 hora or until the peryton Mimics a Shadow again, whichever comes first.

Una grabbed criatura can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} action to get out of the GRAB, y the GRAB ends for a grabbed criaturas if the bear moves away from it.

action->Recall Weapon.name: Recall Weapon

Requisitos Una steeped arma that's no longer sheathed in the purrodaemon's body is a un máximo de 120 pies of the daemon

Efecto El steeped arma swiftly flies through the air to resheath itself in the purrodaemon's body. Si una criatura is along this flight path, the purrodaemon can make a hurled arma Golpe against el objetivo; if it hits, the arma drops to the ground in a square adjacent to la criatura.

action->Steep Weapon.name: Steep Weapon
action->Steep Weapon.description:
El purrodaemon sheathes a arma in their own flesh. Este inflige no daño to the purrodaemon, which can have up to 10 armas sheathed in their body at a time. Una steeped arma must be one that inflige piercing or daño cortante.

Si a purrodaemon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interacts} to crush a soul gem, one arma of their choice sheathed in their flesh queda enchanted with the daemon's fiendish power y queda a +2 greater striking arma that can be used in place of their glaive or hurled at objetivos (with a +2 bonificador por objeto to the hurled arma's attack modifier y an extra d10 of daño). Este magical quality fades 24 horas after it ceases being sheathed in the daemon's living body. Una steeped arma can be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarmed}.

action->Twist the Blade.name: Twist the Blade
action->Twist the Blade.description:
Requisitos El purrodaemon has fewer than 10 armas sheathed in their body

Desencadenante El purrodaemon is hit with a arma that inflige daño perforante

Efecto El purrodaemon seizes the triggering arma. El arma's wielder debe intentar @Check[reflex|dc:40] salvación. Con un fallo, the arma is disarmed y falls to an adjacent square. On a fallo crítico, the arma is sheathed in the purrodaemon's body as though the daemon had used Steep Weapon.

spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Cada sheds light like a torch. Cuando tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Cada light must remain a un máximo de 120 pies of tú y a un máximo de 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

consumable->Lethargy Poison.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]

Lethargy poison is commonly used in hit-and-run tactics by drow y others who want their victims alive; the ambusher retreats until the poison sets in y the victim falls unconscious. Further exposure to lethargy poison does not require el objetivo to attempt additional tiradas de salvación; only failing an tirada de salvación against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Activar 2 INTERACT (Injury)

Tirada de salvación DC 18 Fortaleza

Si the quickling ever queda ralentizado, they lose their supernatural speed, no puede Fade from View, y quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for the duration of the slow. They also no puede reduce this sickened condition for the duration of the ralentizado effect.

action->Fade from View.name: Fade from View
action->Fade from View.description:
Requisitos El quickling used no attack, manipulate, or move actions in the previous round

Efecto El quickling queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} until it uses an attack, manipulate, or move action.

El quickling no puede use Fade from View again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Fade from View]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Supernatural Velocidad.description: El quickling's speed, combined with nearly instantaneous acceleration y deceleration, enables them to move in astonishing ways. As long as they have a firm surface to travel across, they can Zancada their full movement vertically or horizontally. They can even run across unstable surfaces, such as water, in the same way, although dangerous surfaces (acid, lava, etc.) harm them as normal. They must end their movement on a horizontal surface capable of bearing their weight or else they fall.

Requisitos El quoppopak's ventral tube is in water

Efecto El quoppopak uses Tentacle Stab against una criatura a un máximo de reach; if either of these Golpes hits, la criatura debe intentar @Check[reflex|dc:30|traits:damaging-effect] salvación. On a failed save, the quoppopak shoots water through its tentacles into la criatura, dealing @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] daño y making la criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as its internal organs fill with water (double daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a fallo crítico).

action->Tentacle Stab.name: Tentacle Stab
action->Tentacle Stab.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto El quoppopak makes two tentacle Golpes against the same criatura. Estos Golpes deal daño perforante instead of bludgeoning, y the quoppopak no puede @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{GRAB} with them. Its multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks.

action->Water Glide.name: Water Glide
action->Water Glide.description: El quoppopak can stand y move on the surface of water or other liquids without falling through. It can go underwater if it wishes, but it must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} to do so.

Radiant Warden.name: Guardian radiante
Radiant Warden.publicNotes: Los guardianes radiantes son custodios celestiales de lugares sagrados y reliquias luminosas. Su luz protege aliados y quema unas criaturas impias.

spell->Scintillating Pattern.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uEyfLoFQsRKBRIcB]
Scintillating Pattern

Dimensional Lock

spell->Dimension Door (At will).name:

Puerta dimensional (a voluntad)

action->Gatekeeper Aura.name: Gatekeeper Aura
action->Gatekeeper Aura.description: 60 pies. Una criatura that uses a teleportation ability a un máximo de the aura's emanation or enters it via a teleportation ability must succeed a @Check[will|dc:38] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} y have its destination changed to a point of the radiant warden's choosing a un máximo de the emanation. Con un exitoful save, la criatura arrives as intended but is still sickened 1.

action->Orrery.name: Orrery
action->Orrery.description: Until it acts, the radiant warden appears to be an orrery (or similar large mechanical contraption, such as a telescope). It has an automatic result of 53 on pruebas de ENGANO y DCs to convincingly pass as such a machine.

action->Radiant Blast.name: Radiant Blast
action->Radiant Blast.description: El radiant warden releases a @Template[cone|distance:50] of bright energy that inflige @Damage[10d12[force]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). El radiant warden no puede use Radiant Blast for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiant Blast]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Radiant Blow.name: Radiant Blow
action->Radiant Blow.description: Cuando una criatura is hit by the radiant warden's hammer Golpe, a flash of radiant energy attempts to anchor la criatura in place. La criatura debe intentar @Check[will|dc:38] salvación; on a failure, la criatura no puede use any teleportation effects for 1 minuto. On a fallo crítico, la criatura is also permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado}.

Raven.name: Cuervo
Raven.publicNotes: Los cuervos son aves inteligentes y oportunistas, asociadas a campos de batalla, presagios y carroña.

action->Cunning.name: Astucia
action->Cunning.description: Una raven can use simple items as tools, such as poking a stick at an opening to tease out a piece of food. They are also quite adept at stealing objects. Una raven no puede use Latrocinio to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{PICK Una LOCK}, but it can use Latrocinio to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} light objects that it can carry in its beak or talons or to accomplish other relatively simple tasks.

Raven Swarm.name: Enjambre de cuervos
Raven Swarm.publicNotes: Un enjambre de cuervos desciende como una nube de picos y alas negras, confundiendo y desgarrando a quienes quedan atrapados en su interior.

action->Enraged Cunning.name: Enraged Cunning
action->Enraged Cunning.description: There are few things as dangerously persistent in the natural world as an angry unkindness of ravens. Una raven swarm can hound its prey through most barriers. Simple latches, unsecured chimney flues, loosely shuttered windows, y similar obstacles rarely keep an unkindness away. Una raven swarm attempts a Latrocinio check to bypass many of these simple obstructions, typically against DC 20.

action->Swarming Beaks.name: Picos en enjambre
action->Swarming Beaks.description: Los picotazos furiosos de los cuervos infligen @Damage[1d8[piercing]] de daño a cada enemigo en el espacio del enjambre (salvación básica de @Check[reflex|dc:20]). Una criatura que falle criticamente queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegada} durante [[/gmr 1d4 #Duracion Cegado]]{1d4 asaltos}, mientras los cuervos concentran sus ataques en la cara vulnerable del objetivo.

Ravener.name: Ravener
Ravener.publicNotes: Un ravener es el cadaver animado de un dragón que devoro su propia alma para aferrarse a la no muerte. Hambrea energía vital y magia con la desesperacion de una eternidad vacia.
Ravener.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Wall of Fire (At Will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]
Muro de fuego (a voluntad)

spell->Suggestion (At Will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]
Sugestión (a voluntad)

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: Smoke doesn't impair an ancient red ravener's visión; it ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} condition from smoke.

action->Soulsense.name: Soulsense
action->Soulsense.description: Una ravener senses the spiritual essence of living y undead criaturas a un máximo de the listed range. Las criaturas whose material bodies are one unit with their souls, like celestials y fiends, appear brighter to this sense.

Jaws only.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Cowering Fear.name: Cowering Fear
action->Cowering Fear.description:
90 pies. @Check[will|dc:42]

Una ravener's frightful presence causes criaturas to cower in fear as well. As long as una criatura is at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} or more as a result of the ravener's frightful presence, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} from the fear.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Discorporate.name: Discorporate
action->Discorporate.description:
Desencadenante El ravener recibe excess daño to their soul ward but still has at least 51 PG in their soul ward

Efecto El ravener draws deeply into their soul ward, discorporating their body into soul energy in order to escape. They take 50 daño to their soul ward y their physical body vanishes, reappearing [[/r 1d4 #horas]]{1d4 horas} later in a random location a un máximo de 1 mile from the location where they used Discorporate.

action->Redirect Fire.name: Redirect Fire
action->Redirect Fire.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura a un máximo de 100 pies casts a fire conjuro, or a fire conjuro otherwise comes into effect from a source a un máximo de 100 pies

Efecto El ravener makes all the choices to determine el objetivos, destination, y other effects of the conjuro, as though they were the caster.

action->Soul Ward.name: Salvaguarda del alma
action->Soul Ward.description:
200 PG

An intangible field of necromantic energy protects a ravener from total destruction. Una soul ward has 150 maximum PG, or 200 if the ravener is level 21 or higher. Siempre que a ravener would be reduced below 1 Hit Point, all daño in excess of what would reduce them to 1 Hit Point is instead dealt to their soul ward. Si this daño reduces the soul ward to fewer than 0 PG, the ravener is destroyed. Una soul ward's PG can be restored only via specific ravener abilities such as Consume Soul, ravenous breath, or vicious criticals. Una ravener who goes more than a week without successfully using Consume Soul to feed on a dying criatura starves, y their soul ward loses @Damage[1d4[healing]] PG each day until they feed. Si the ravener's soul ward loses all its PG mientras el ravener still has more than 1 PG, they quedan a ravener husk.

action->Consume Soul.name: Consume Soul
action->Consume Soul.description:
DC 44

Desencadenante Una living criatura a un máximo de 30 pies of the ravener dies

Efecto El ravener tears la criatura's soul from its body with their maw y gulps it down. El dying criatura debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:44] salvación with the same DC as the ravener's Arma de aliento.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectada.

Éxito El ravener tears off a small chunk of la criatura's soul. Si the victim is restored to life, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1} in addition to any other side effects of returning to life. El ravener adds a number of PG to their soul ward equal to half la criatura's level.

Fallo Como éxito, but la criatura's soul is ravaged. La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 3} y the ravener adds a number of PG to their soul ward equal to la criatura's level.

Fallo crítico Como fallo, but the ravener devours the entire soul. El victim no puede be restored to life as long as the ravener exists except via a 10th-rank effect such as miracle or wish, y the ravener adds a number of PG to their soul ward equal to twice la criatura's level.

action->Manipulate Flames.name: Manipulate Flames
action->Manipulate Flames.description: El ravener attempts to take control of a magical fire or a fire conjuro a un máximo de 100 pies. Si it succeeds at a counteract check (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier +34), the original caster loses control of the conjuro or magical fire, control is transferred to the ravener, y this action counts as the ravener having Sustained the Spell with the action (if applicable). El ravener can elige to end the conjuro instead of taking control, if they elige.

action->Ravenous Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Ravenous Breath Weapon.description:
El ravener breathes a blast of flame that inflige @Damage[20d6[fire],4d6[persistent,void]|options:area-damage]{20d6 daño de fuego más 4d6 daño persistente de vacío} (@Check[reflex|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). Una criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 2} on a fallo crítico). Si una criatura is drained by the ravener's Ravenous Arma de aliento, the ravener's soul ward gains @Damage[5[healing]] PG.

El ravener no puede use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Vicious Criticals.name: Vicious Criticals
action->Vicious Criticals.description: El ravener treats an tirada de ataque as a impacto crítico on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the tirada de ataque was a success. Additionally, siempre que the ravener makes a impacto crítico with one of their Golpes, el objetivo must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] salvación or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1} condition. Si el objetivo already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. Siempre que the ravener applies drain to una criatura in this way, their soul ward gains 5 PG.

Ravener Husk.name: Cascaron de ravener
Ravener Husk.publicNotes: Un cascaron de ravener es el resto degradado de un ravener, todavia peligroso pese a haber perdido gran parte de su poder y voluntad.

action->Soulsense.name: Soulsense
action->Soulsense.description: Una ravener senses the spiritual essence of living y undead criaturas a un máximo de the listed range. Las criaturas whose material bodies are one unit with their souls, like celestials y fiends, appear brighter to this sense.

action->Boneshatter.name: Boneshatter
action->Boneshatter.description:
Desencadenante El ravener husk recibe any amount of daño contundente

Efecto El ravener's brittle bones shatter, spraying bone shards everywhere. Every criatura a un máximo de a @Template[emanation|distance:10] of the ravener husk recibe @Damage[7d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:31|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

90 pies. @Check[will|dc:31]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
El ravener husk breathes a torrent of void energy that inflige @Damage[16d6[void]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:40] (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

No puede volver a usar su arma de aliento durante [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Ravenous Repast.name: Ravenous Repast
action->Ravenous Repast.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto El ravener husk makes a jaws Golpe against a deceased criatura that has been dead no longer than 1 minuto, was good aligned, y was at least level 15 in life. El ravener attempts a @Check[flat|dc:5] check; if successful, they transform back into a ravener with 1 Hit Point in their soul ward.

action->Vicious Criticals.name: Vicious Criticals
action->Vicious Criticals.description: El ravener treats an tirada de ataque as a impacto crítico on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the tirada de ataque was a success. Additionally, siempre que the ravener makes a impacto crítico with one of their Golpes, el objetivo must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] salvación or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1} condition. Si el objetivo already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. Siempre que the ravener applies drain to una criatura in this way, their soul ward gains 5 PG.

Red Dracolisk.name: Dracolisco rojo
Red Dracolisk.publicNotes: Los dracoliscos rojos combinan la ferocidad de los dragones rojos con el poder petrificante de los basiliscos. Su aliento ardiente y su mirada los convierten en depredadores temibles.

action->Tremorsense 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Sentido sismico 30 pies

action->Draconic Resistance.name: Resistencia draconica
action->Draconic Resistance.description: Una red dracolisk has resistance 10 to daño de fuego.

action->Petrifying Glance.name: Mirada petrificante
action->Petrifying Glance.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura a un máximo de 30 pies that the dracolisk can see empieza su turno

Efecto El objetivo debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:26] salvación. Si it fails, it queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minuto as its body stiffens.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
El red dracolisk breathes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Este breath arma inflige @Damage[6d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño, with a @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] salvación.

El dracolisk no puede use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Petrifying Gaze.name: Mirada fija petrificante
action->Petrifying Gaze.description:
El dracolisk stares at una criatura it can see a un máximo de 30 pies. That criatura debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:28] salvación. Si it fails y has not already been ralentizado by Petrifying Glance or this ability, it queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. Si la criatura already was ralentizado by this ability or Petrifying Glance, a failed save causes la criatura to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} permanently.

Una criatura petrified in this manner can be instantly restored to flesh by being coated (not just splashed) with fresh dracolisk or basilisk blood no more than 1 hora old. Una single dracolisk contains enough blood to coat [[/r 1d4+2 #Medium criaturas]] Medium criaturas in this manner.

action->Savage Jaws.name: Mandíbulas salvajes
action->Savage Jaws.description: El dracolisk makes a single Golpe with its jaws. Si the attack hits, it inflige @Damage[(4d12+16)[piercing]] daño (versatile S). Este counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalizador.

Reef Octopus.name: Pulpo de arrecife
Reef Octopus.publicNotes: Los pulpos de arrecife se ocultan entre corales y grietas submarinas, usando camuflaje y tentaculos para atrapar presas.

action->Camouflage.name: Camuflaje
action->Camouflage.description: El reef octopus can change the color of its skin to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} even if it doesn't have cover.

action->Ink Cloud.name: Ink Cloud
action->Ink Cloud.description:
El reef octopus emits a cloud of dark-brown ink in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]. Este cloud has no effect outside of water. Las criaturas inside the cloud are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} y no puede use their sense of smell. El cloud dissipates after 1 minuto.

El octopus no puede use Ink Cloud again for [[/br 2d6 #Recharge Ink Cloud]]{2d6 asaltos}.

action->Jet.name: Chorro
action->Jet.description: El reef octopus moves up to 80 pies in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.

action->Reef Octopus Venom.name: Reef Octopus Venom
action->Reef Octopus Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño y Desprevenido (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[1d8[poison]] daño y Desprevenido (1 asalto)

action->Writhing Arms.name: Writhing Arms
action->Writhing Arms.description: El reef octopus makes up to four arm Golpes with different arms, each against a different objetivo. Estos attacks count toward the octopus's multiple attack penalizador, but the multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after it makes all of its attacks.

Rusalka.name: Rusalka
Rusalka.publicNotes: Las rusalkas son muertos vivientes acuaticos nacidos de muertes tragicas por ahogamiento o traicion. Atraen a vivos hacia el agua para compartir su destino.

spell->Water Walk (Constant).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Seaah9amXg70RKw2]
Caminar sobre las aguas (constante)

spell->Charm (At will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]
Encantar (a voluntad)

spell->Control Water (At will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zfn5RqAdF63neqpP]
Controlar agua (a voluntad)

spell->Invisibility (At will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]
Invisibilidad (a voluntad)

spell->Obscuring Mist (At will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]
Niebla de oscurecimiento (a voluntad)

action->Beckoning Call.name: Beckoning Call
action->Beckoning Call.description:
El rusalka cries out a compelling invitation. Cada non-fey criatura a un máximo de a @Template[emanation|distance:300] debe intentar @Check[will|dc:27] salvación. El effect lasts for 1 asalto, but if the rusalka uses Beckoning Call again on subsequent asaltos, the duration extends by 1 asalto for all affected criaturas. Once una criatura succeeds at any save against Beckoning Call, that criatura is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

Éxito La criatura no se ve afectada.

Fallo La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} y must spend each of its actions to move closer to the rusalka, avoiding obvious dangers. Si a beckoned criatura is adjacent to the rusalka, it stays still y doesn't act. Si attacked by the rusalka, la criatura is freed from captivation at the end of the rusalka's turn.

Fallo crítico Como fallo, but if attacked by the rusalka, la criatura can attempt a new save only at the start of its next turn, rather than being freed at the end of the rusalka's turn.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(2d8+10)[bludgeoning]], @Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Entangling Tresses.name: Entangling Tresses
action->Entangling Tresses.description: Una rusalka can have up to eight criaturas grabbed a un máximo de their tresses at a time.

action->Flowing Hair.name: Flowing Hair
action->Flowing Hair.description: El rusalka attempts an @Check[athletics] check against each @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} criatura's CD de Fortaleza. El rusalka moves cada criatura they succeed against up to 10 pies y cada criatura they critically succeed against up to 20 pies. Este movement must all be a un máximo de reach of its tresses.

action->Shameful Touch.name: Shameful Touch
action->Shameful Touch.description:
El rusalka touches una criatura a un máximo de 5 pies using their hand, stirring up memories of regret y shame. El objetivo debe intentar @Check[will|dc:35] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo no se ve afectado.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo crítico La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, y it must use its first action on its next turn to Golpe itself, automatically hitting.

Sacristan.name: Sacristan
Sacristan.publicNotes: Los sacristanes son velstracs especializados en dolor, musica y mutilacion ritual. Sus instrumentos quirurgicos convierten la carne en una partitura de sufrimiento.
Sacristan.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Painsight.name: Vision del dolor
action->Painsight.description: Una velstrac automatically knows whether una criatura it sees has any of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Herido} conditions, as well as the value of those conditions

action->Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.lR9R5Vld8Eu2Dha5]
Regeneración 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)

action->Staggering Servitude.name: Staggering Servitude
action->Staggering Servitude.description: 30 pies. Cuando una criatura ends its turn in the aura, it sees a visión of the sacristan groveling in pitiable servitude. La criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:27] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

action->Focus Gaze.name: Focus Gaze
action->Focus Gaze.description: El sacristan stares at una criatura they can see a un máximo de 30 pies. La criatura must immediately attempt a Voluntad save against Staggering Servitude. In addition, if la criatura was already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}, on a failed save its revulsion toward the sacristan's presence causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Estupefacta 2} for 1 minuto. After attempting this save, la criatura is then temporarily immune until the start of the sacristan's next turn.

action->Shadow Scream.name: Shadow Scream
action->Shadow Scream.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto El sacristan opens their mouth to unloose the wailing howls y mind-twisting darkness of the Shadow Plane. Este creates a @Template[emanation|distance:30] of darkness y wailing sounds around the sacristan. Las criaturas with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.qCCLZhnp2HhP3Ex6]{Darkvision} no puede see through this darkness. El sacristan can Sustain Shadow Scream for up to 1 minuto. Non-velstrac criaturas in the área when the ability is used, as well as those who enter or start their turn in the área, debe intentar @Check[will|dc:28|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:deafened] salvación.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectado y is then temporarily immune for 24 horas.

Éxito La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnPGR]{Deafened} for 1 asalto.

Fallo La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confusa} y deafened for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico La criatura recibe @Damage[20[mental]|options:area-damage] daño, y is confused y deafened for 1 asalto.

Sand Sentry.name: Centinela de arena
Sand Sentry.publicNotes: Los centinelas de arena son guardianes elementales que se alzan desde dunas y ruinas para aplastar intrusos.

action->Tremorsense 60 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Sentido sismico 60 pies

action->Glass Armor.name: Glass Armor
action->Glass Armor.description: Cuando the sand sentry recibe fire or lightning daño, its outer layer of sand fuses into sheets of hardened glass for 1 minuto. Este increases the sand sentry's AC to 26 y grants it resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, y daño cortante. Una sand sentry no puede use earth glide mientras glass armor is active.

action->Blinding Sand.name: Blinding Sand
action->Blinding Sand.description: Cuando the sand sentry critically hits with a fist Golpe, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

action->Earth Glide.name: Earth Glide
action->Earth Glide.description: Una sand sentry can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through earthen matter, including rock. Cuando it does so, it moves at its full burrow Velocidad, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

Sandpoint Devil.name: Diablo de Sandpoint
Sandpoint Devil.publicNotes: El diablo de Sandpoint es una bestia legendaria envuelta en rumores, fuego y miedo rural. Sus apariciones anuncian desgracia para granjas y caminos aislados.
Sandpoint Devil.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Dimension Door.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]
Puerta dimensional

spell->Obscuring Mist.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]
Niebla de oscurecimiento

spell->Gust of Wind (At will).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]
Ráfaga de viento (a voluntad)

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
Una pequeña esfera de fuego aparece en la palma de tu mano y la lanzas contra el objetivo, en cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia. Realiza una tirada de ataque de conjuro contra la CA del objetivo. Normalmente es un ataque a distancia, pero también puedes realizar un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo contra una criatura dentro de tu alcance sin armas.

Con un éxito, infliges 2d4 de daño de fuego. Con un éxito crítico, el objetivo recibe el doble de daño y @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] de daño persistente de fuego.

Aumentado (+1) Aumenta el daño en 1d4 y el daño persistente con un impacto crítico en 1d4.

action->Attack of Opportunity (Hoof Only.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]
Ataque de oportunidad (Hoof Only)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Hoof Only.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]

Hoof only

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Accursed Breath.name: Accursed Breath
action->Accursed Breath.description:
El Sandpoint Devil breathes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of flame that inflige @Damage[6d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño. Cada criatura in the área debe intentar @Check[reflex|dc:26|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:sickened] salvación.

El Sandpoint Devil no puede use Accursed Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Accursed Breath]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectada.

Éxito La criatura recibe half daño.

Fallo La criatura recibe full daño y is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} by the agonizing pain of its burns.

Fallo crítico La criatura recibe full daño y is cursed. El victim's flesh appears charred y burned, y the pain of being burned alive never fully vanishes. El cursed criatura recibe a –2 penalizador de estado to all checks from the constant pain. Healing doesn't alter the appearance of the burns or lessen the penalizador, but removing the curse does.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.hjYNxH7BwkrzwVsE]{Efecto: Accursed Breath (Fallo crítico)}

action->Devil's Howl.name: Devil's Howl
action->Devil's Howl.description:
El Sandpoint Devil unleashes a bloodcurdling howl that can be heard for miles. Cada criatura a un máximo de a @Template[emanation|distance:100] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3} y fleeing as long as it remains asustado on a fallo crítico).

Las criaturas that attempt this Voluntad save are then immune to Devil's Howl for 24 horas.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Medium or smaller, hoof, @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Sard.name: Sard
Sard.publicNotes: Los sards son criaturas petreas y obstinadas, vinculadas a la tierra dura y a vetas minerales.
Sard.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Control Weather (Doesn't require.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]
Control Weather (Doesn't require secondary casters)

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Sentido sismico 120 pies

action->Planar Acclimation.name: Planar Acclimation
action->Planar Acclimation.description: El sard treats the plane it is located on as its home plane.

action->Splintering Death.name: Splintering Death
action->Splintering Death.description: Cuando the sard dies, its body explodes in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. All criaturas in the área take @Damage[10d6[electricity],10d6[piercing]|options:area-damage]{10d6 daño de electricidad y 10d6 daño perforante} (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). Cualquier criatura that recibe daño perforante is also exposed to sard venom.

action->Lightning-Struck Curse.name: Lightning-Struck Curse
action->Lightning-Struck Curse.description:
Desencadenante El sard is about to daño una criatura that has electricity resistance

Efecto An instant before el objetivo recibe the daño de electricidad from the triggering event, the sard's electrical sparks glow red. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:41] salvación or lose any electricity resistance it has until this curse is lifted.

action->Sard Venom.name: Sard Venom
action->Sard Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:41]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[2d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[3d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[4d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 asalto)

action->Thorn Volley.name: Thorn Volley
action->Thorn Volley.description: El sard makes up to four thorn Golpes, each against a different objetivo. El sard's multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after all the attacks have been made.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Enorme o menor, root, @Check[reflex|dc:39|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Sceaduinar.name: Sceaduinar
Sceaduinar.publicNotes: Los sceaduinars son habitantes del vacío entre vida y muerte, resentidos contra la energía positiva y todo lo que vive.
Sceaduinar.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Dimension Door.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]
Puerta dimensional

spell->Chill Touch.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mAMEt4FFbdqoRnkN]
Chill Touch

action->Lifesense 120 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]
Sentido vital 120 pies

action->Void Child.name: Void Child
action->Void Child.description: Sceaduinars have neither souls nor the ability to create. Una sceaduinar es inmune to effects that objetivo a soul (such as bind soul or resurrect) or that require knowledge of una criatura's identity (such as scrying), y critically fails CRAFTING checks.

action->Wing Flash.name: Wing Flash
action->Wing Flash.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura attempts a melee attack against a sceaduinar or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} the sceaduinar's space

Efecto El sceaduinar flexes its wings to emit a brief pulse of void energy that inflige @Damage[4d6[void]] daño to the triggering criatura (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] salvación).

action->Drain Life.name: Drenar La Vida
action->Drain Life.description:
Cuando the sceaduinar damages a living criatura with its jaws Golpe, the sceaduinar gains 5 PG temporales y la criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|options:inflicts:drained] salvación or quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenada 1}.

Further daño dealt to la criatura by the sceaduinar increases the drained value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{Efecto: Drenar vida}

action->Entropic Touch.name: Entropic Touch
action->Entropic Touch.description: Void daño dealt by a sceaduinar damages undead y criaturas with curación de vacío as if it were vitality daño. El sceaduinar's melee Golpes have the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune on attacks against incorporeal undead.

Scythe Tree.name: Arbol guadana
Scythe Tree.publicNotes: Un arbol guadana parece vegetacion retorcida hasta que sus ramas afiladas caen como cuchillas sobre criaturas cercanas.

action->Lifesense 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]
Sentido vital 30 pies

action->Axe Vulnerability 5.name: Axe Vulnerability 5
action->Axe Vulnerability 5.description: Una scythe tree recibe 5 daño adicional from axes.

action->Ripping Disarm.name: Ripping Disarm
action->Ripping Disarm.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura rolls a fallo crítico on a melee arma Golpe against the scythe tree

Efecto El scythe tree attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} la criatura.

action->Dead Tree.name: Dead Tree
action->Dead Tree.description: Until the scythe tree acts, it appears to be a dead tree. It has an automatic result of 35 on pruebas de ENGANO y DCs to pass as a dead tree.

action->Woodland Ambush.name: Woodland Ambush
action->Woodland Ambush.description:
Requisitos El scythe tree is using Dead Tree in forested terrain, y una criatura that hasn't detected it is a un máximo de 30 pies

Efecto El scythe tree Strides up to 25 pies toward the triggering criatura. Once la criatura is in reach, the scythe tree makes a scythe branch Golpe against it. La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against this Golpe.

Sea Drake.name: Draco marino
Sea Drake.publicNotes: Los dracos marinos son depredadores draconicos de costas y mares. Atacan barcos pequenos, cuevas litorales y presas que se aventuran demasiado lejos de la orilla.

action->Electrified Blood.name: Electrified Blood
action->Electrified Blood.description:
Desencadenante An adjacent criatura inflige piercing or daño cortante to the sea drake

Efecto An arc of electricity courses through the sea drake's blood. El triggering criatura recibe @Damage[1d6[electricity]] daño.

action->Ball Lightning Breath.name: Ball Lightning Breath
action->Ball Lightning Breath.description:
El sea drake spews a ball of electricity that strikes a primary objetivo a un máximo de 100 pies, dealing @Damage[7d6[electricity]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] salvación). El lightning then arcs to up to three secondary objetivos a un máximo de 30 pies of the primary objetivo, striking the closest available objetivos first. El secondary bolts each strike one secondary objetivo y deal the same rolled daño value as the primary bolt (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] salvación).

El sea drake no puede use Ball Lightning Breath again for [[/gmr 1d6 #Recharge Ball Lightning Breath]]{1d6 asaltos}.

action->Briny Wound.name: Briny Wound
action->Briny Wound.description:
Una sea drake's saliva carries a large quantity of salt, making its bite wounds even more painful. Cuando una criatura recibe daño from a sea drake's jaws Golpe, la criatura debe intentar @Check[fortitude|dc:24] salvación; la criatura is then temporarily immune to briny wound for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico La criatura no se ve afectada.

Éxito La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo La criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Fallo crítico La criatura is Sickened 2 y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it's sickened.

action->Capsize.name: Capsize
action->Capsize.description: El drake tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. El drake must succeed at an Atletismo check with a DC of 25 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the drake) or the pilot's Sailing LORE DC, whichever is higher.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El sea drake makes one jaws Golpe y two tail Golpes in any order.

action->Velocidad Surge.name: Velocidad Surge
action->Velocidad Surge.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Efecto El sea drake Strides, Flies, or Swims twice.

Sea Snake.name: Serpiente marina
Sea Snake.publicNotes: Las serpientes marinas son reptiles venenosos que cazan en aguas calidas y arrecifes.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: El sea snake can hold its breath for about an hour.

action->Lash Out.name: Lash Out
action->Lash Out.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura a un máximo de the sea snake's reach uses a move action

Efecto El sea snake makes a bite Golpe against the attacker.

action->Sea Snake Venom.name: Sea Snake Venom
action->Sea Snake Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitada 1} (1 asalto)

Shadow Drake.name: Draco sombrio
Shadow Drake.publicNotes: Los dracos sombrios son criaturas taimadas que usan oscuridad, veneno y emboscadas para abatir a sus enemigos.

action->Shadow Blend.name: Shadow Blend
action->Shadow Blend.description: El shadow drake's form shifts y blends reflexively with surrounding shadows. Una shadow drake gains an additional reaction each round, but it can use this reaction only for Shadow Evade.

action->Shadow Evade.name: Shadow Evade
action->Shadow Evade.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura attacks the shadow drake mientras it is in an área of dim light

Efecto El shadow drake further obscures its position. El attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] check in order to affect the shadow drake, as if the drake were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} for el ataque desencadenante.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El shadow drake makes one bite Golpe y two tail Golpes in any order.

action->Shadow Breath.name: Shadow Breath
action->Shadow Breath.description:
Una shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid that explodes into a cloud of frigid black shadow. Este attack has a range of 40 pies y explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-pies-radius burst}. Las criaturas a un máximo de the burst take @Damage[3d6[cold]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). El explosión of shadow also snuffs out mundane light sources the size of a torch, lantern, or smaller, y attempts to counteract magical light with a [[/r 1d20+10 #Counteract Light]]{+10} counteract modifier.

El shadow drake no puede use Shadow Breath again for [[/gmr 1d6 #Recharge Shadow Breath]] asaltos.

action->Velocidad Surge.name: Velocidad Surge
action->Velocidad Surge.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Efecto El shadow drake Strides or Flies twice.

Shoal Linnorm.name: Linnorm de bajio
Shoal Linnorm.publicNotes: Los linnorms de bajio son dragones primigenios crueles que acechan costas frias, arrecifes y aguas poco profundas.
Shoal Linnorm.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Freedom of Movement (Constant).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]
Libertad de movimiento (constante)

spell->True Seeing (Constant).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]
True Seeing (Constant)

action->Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.lR9R5Vld8Eu2Dha5]
Regeneración 10 (Desactivada por frío Iron)

action->Attack of Opportunity (Tail Only.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]
Ataque de oportunidad (solo cola)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Tail Only.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]

Tail only.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Curse of Drowning.name: Curse of Drowning
action->Curse of Drowning.description: Cuando una criatura slays a shoal linnorm, it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:38] salvación or quedan cursed. As long as the curse of drowning persists, the character must spend 3 actions when drinking any liquid. Attempting to drink liquid faster causes the victim to begin drowning, immediately running out of air y falling unconscious.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
El shoal linnorm exhales scalding steam that inflige @Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). El steam lingers until the end of the linnorm's next turn; anyone who enters the área or begins their turn in the área recibe @Damage[6d8[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:36|traits:damaging-effect] salvación negates). During this time, the steam is so thick that it impedes movement as well as sight, turning the área into terreno dificil. All criaturas in the steam quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, y all criaturas outside the steam quedan concealed to criaturas a un máximo de it.

El shoal linnorm no puede use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Shoal Linnorm Venom.name: Shoal Linnorm Venom
action->Shoal Linnorm Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:36]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 2 @Damage[6d6[fire]] daño y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitada 2} (1 asalto).

Shocker Lizard.name: Lagarto electrico
Shocker Lizard.publicNotes: Los lagartos electricos generan descargas coordinadas, y en grupo pueden liberar estallidos de electricidad peligrosos.

action->Greater Electrolocation.name: Greater Electrolocation
action->Greater Electrolocation.description: Una shocker lizard can sense minute electrical charges in living criaturas, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 pies. Este distance increases to 100 pies against any criatura that has used an electricity effect a un máximo de the last minute.

action->Amplify Voltage.name: Amplify Voltage
action->Amplify Voltage.description:
Desencadenante Una shocker lizard a un máximo de 20 pies makes a shock Golpe or uses Discharge

Efecto El shocker lizard lends some of its electrical power to the nearby lizard. Este either causes the other lizard's shock Golpe to lose the nonlethal rasgo or increases the DC of its Discharge to 20.

action->Discharge.name: Discharge
action->Discharge.description:
El shocker lizard releases a blast of lightning from its body. Las criaturas a un máximo de a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[3d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

El shocker lizard no puede use Discharge for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Discharge]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Shocking Burst.name: Shocking Burst
action->Shocking Burst.description:
El shocker lizard hunkers down y begins to spark with electricity, which it releases in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] that inflige @Damage[3d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

El shocker lizard no puede use Shocking Burst again for 1 minuto.

Up to four shocker lizards can combine their Shocking Bursts. In this case, the lizards can delay the release of their electricity until any other shocker lizard a un máximo de 30 pies completes its Shocking Burst. El combined Shocking Bursts create an emanation with the combined área from all participating shocker lizards. For each additional shocker lizard that joins the burst, the daño increases by 3d8 y the save DC increases by 1 (to a maximum of four lizards dealing 12d8 daño with a DC 21 save).

Shoggti.name: Shoggti
Shoggti.publicNotes: Los shoggti son qlippothas que esclavizan mentes y moldean carne, guiados por una inteligencia maligna anterior a los demonios.

spell->Dimension Door.name:
